name: +1 Wings Keyboard Escape
desc:
Welcome to +1 Wings Keyboard Escape

⚡ Every Fly = +1 Speed
🤸 Fly, jump, and escape across a Biomes made of candy & chocolate keyboard keys
👟 Train your speed and unlock powerful Wings
👥 Race against friends and other players
🌍 Become the FASTEST player on the server

🎧 ASMR vibes included
Smooth movement, satisfying keyboard clicks, creamy visuals, and relaxing candy sounds for the perfect mix of speed, fly, and chill
